```yaml
name: Update Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    # Run weekly on Monday at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install nox

      - name: Clone open-webui as shallow copy
        run: |
          # Remove existing folder if it exists
          rm -rf open-webui
          # Clone as shallow copy without .git directory to save space and avoid submodule issues
          git clone --depth 1 --no-tags https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui-temp
          # Remove .git directory to exclude from builds and avoid submodule conflicts
          rm -rf open-webui-temp/.git
          # Move to final location
          mv open-webui-temp open-webui

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          # Create or update contributor docs mentioning the new open-webui folder
          mkdir -p docs
          cat > docs/CONTRIBUTING.md << 'EOF'
          # Contributing to Open WebUI Developer Toolkit

          ## Open WebUI Folder
          The `open-webui` folder contains a synced copy of the open-webui repository.
          This folder is automatically updated weekly via GitHub Actions.
          Do not commit changes directly to this folder.
          EOF

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          # Add mention of automated sync to README if not already present
          if ! grep -q "automated sync" README.md; then
            echo "" >> README.md
            echo "## Automated Sync" >> README.md
            echo "This repository includes an automated weekly sync of the open-webui repository." >> README.md
            echo "The sync is performed via GitHub Actions and updates the \`open-webui\` folder." >> README.md
          fi

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          nox -s lint tests

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add open-webui docs/CONTRIBUTING.md README.md
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: sync open-webui and update docs"
          git push origin main
```
